sections.Profile:
The "Merry-Go-Round" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in December 1960, is a two-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker. The machine features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, and three gobble holes.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1960
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
